name: short-value-copy
what: time of copied_string for one value under 16 bytes, in a loop over a list of values that moves the output position by the count, as a render does; ns per value
purpose_in_the_task_list: Task c08c8baf, plan A4, after commit 4: the reflection render of workload 2 on g++-16 lost 45 to 48 percent when the short-string read was removed; the owner asked for a form that is as fast and safe; on 2026-11-14 the owner allowed a read inside the capacity of the string
method: not the method of mbedded-cbor/bench/README.md: 6 rounds, the arm order alternates by round (forward, then reversed), each process 5 repetitions of 2^22 values for each input, timed with std::chrono::steady_clock; arm 1 is arm 0 built twice; each arm is held to the scalar form (every length 0 to 40 with no mark and with each mark at each position, the same with marks written behind the size through resize_and_overwrite, and every value of the inputs) before it is timed; no gate, no steal

arms.0: the form of dbd4cac: a value of up to 16 bytes in a string whose capacity() + 1 >= 16 is read as one 16-byte block (_mm_loadu_si128), the marks masked to the length
arms.1: the same code as arm 0, a second binary: the noise of the cell
arms.2: the form of d13b6ca: a value under 16 bytes takes std::copy_n with a run-time length and std::ranges::any_of(s, is_marked)
arms.3: a value under 16 bytes: one block built in a zeroed std::array<char, 16> from overlapping pieces of 8, 4 or 1 bytes inside the length, bit_cast to __m128i, one 16-byte store
arms.4: a value under 16 bytes: one block from two 64-bit words in registers (overlapping pieces inside the length, shifted), one 16-byte store
arms.5: a value under 16 bytes: overlapping pieces of 8, 4 or 1 bytes inside the length, stored piece by piece (nothing stored past the length); marks from the words of the pieces
arms.6: a value under 16 bytes: one 16-byte read through a std::span over data() and capacity() + 1 chars (the terminator counted), one 16-byte store, marks masked to the length
arms.7: as arm 6 with a span over capacity() chars: a short string of libstdc++ (capacity 15) takes arm 5

inputs.render: the values under 16 bytes of bench/render.cpp in render order: workload 2 (rowClass, index, symbol twice, name, price, negativeClass, change, negativeClass, ratio of 20 stocks) then workload 3 (the title twice, then author, date and three tag names of 20 articles); workload 1 has none; marked values: class="minus" and Today's news
inputs.render-plain: the same list with each mark replaced by x
inputs.fixed-N: 64 values of N bytes of x; fixed-N-marked: the last byte is <

strings_of_arm_0: every value is a std::string made from a short string_view, so it lies in the buffer inside the string (libstdc++: capacity() 15, a buffer of 16 chars); main checks capacity() + 1 >= 16 for every value before the run and stops if one fails; arm 0 tests the same in reads_past_size_safely
builds: g++-16 and clang++-23, -O2 and -Os, -march=x86-64-v3 and -march=x86-64-v4, -std=c++26 -DNDEBUG -Wall -Wextra -Werror -falign-functions=64 -falign-loops=64 (g++ also -falign-jumps=64) -DARM=<arm>; one binary for each arm and build
headers: none (probe.cpp holds a copy of the parts of include/mustache/escape.hpp that it needs)
